reviews.body: One change before this merges: `InsecureProductEndpoint` prints the endpoint as entered (`got {url}`), so a URL with `user:pass@` shows the password in the error. `NotReady` already masks its URL in the `#[error]` attribute (`engine/mod.rs:57`, `mask_url(.url)`), and the same works here. The rest matches items 1 and 2 of #1282, and CI passes.
The insecure-endpoint error now masks the URL, and the new test covers it. Approving.

comments.body:
Thanks, good catch. `InsecureProductEndpoint` now formats the URL through `mask_url`, like `NotReady`, so `user:pass@` shows as `user:****@`. Added a test that feeds `http://user:s3cret@mcp.example.com` and checks the password is absent from the message.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
